work_items.name: ors_map — Mapbox Navigation Engine
work_items.description: Open-source Dart/Flutter navigation engine, sometimes described as mapbox_nav_core.

facts.description: Designed a vendor-neutral Dart navigation engine separating route matching/progress calculations from Mapbox rendering, with an architectural boundary test.
Implemented bounded forward-window route matching and binary-search distance lookup; local benchmark reports 40.7–71.2 µs per GPS fix on 10,000-point routes.
Implemented 60 FPS dead-reckoning pose animation from 1 Hz GPS, 3D vehicle rendering and four-mode camera controls.
Documented 118+ unit, fuzz and stress tests with GitHub Actions CI.

Built location-driven follow-camera, recentering and guidance states.
Rendered a GLB vehicle through Mapbox ModelLayer with approximately 16ms frame-based position/bearing updates.

work_items.name: RecruitFlow — AI-Assisted Recruitment ATS
work_items.description: Python and Streamlit recruitment dashboard using Gmail and direct PDFs for resume intake, structured extraction, job-specific ranking and approval-gated outreach. Repo reviewed 15 Nov 2026.

facts.description: Implemented Gmail attachment and direct-PDF intake, PDF parsing and extraction into structured candidate profiles.
Built deterministic ATS matching with required/preferred skills, experience signals and transparent comparison breakdowns.

Supports Gemini extraction, an optional local Antigravity provider and deterministic demo fallback; does not establish production extraction accuracy.
Project documentation reports 21 pytest tests passed on 15 November 2026; does not confirm live Gmail/Sheets integration success.

work_items.name: Live Portfolio AI Representative — Hugging Face / Gradio
work_items.description: Server-side Next.js assistant adapter connected to a Hugging Face Gradio Space. This is distinct from the course-only profile assistant prototype.

facts.description: Integrated /api/assistant with a server-only provider that creates a fresh Gradio session and submits /chat with a message to the hosted Space.
Bounded recent visitor history and current portfolio facts are supplied per request; sessions are closed after completion to avoid cross-visitor state leakage.
Implemented time budgets, labelled local-guide fallback and per-instance upstream cooldown; kept provider secrets server-side.
Production integration was reported to return live llm-mode responses in about 7–8 seconds, and eight transport/provider tests passed.
Hosted Gradio Space uses GPT-4.1-mini and can forward voluntarily supplied contact details or unresolved questions through Pushover.
